fr.elements: Main Residence; Access Drive; Front Driveway; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area; Water Feature; Detached Structure; Open Green Space
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Long Driveway; Open Terrain; Water Feature; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the street entrance to the driveway so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective posts on both sides to define its edges and remain visible at night or in low-visibility conditions.
• Keep the full length of the driveway clear of parked vehicles and equipment so emergency vehicles can reach the residence without stopping to reposition.
• Maintain driveway width and overhead clearance along the entire length to allow fire apparatus and ambulances to pass without obstruction.
• Identify and mark a turnaround area near the residence so emergency vehicles can reposition without backing the full length of the driveway.
• Post the property address visibly at both the street entrance and near the main residence so responders arriving from either point can confirm the correct location.
• Mark the location of the water feature with a visible indicator near the driveway so responders moving across the open lawn at night are aware of it before approaching.
• Identify and mark any path or route that provides the closest approach to the rear of the property, even if informal, so responders are not limited to front-side access only.
• Keep any gates along the driveway unlocked or equipped with a Knox Box or coded lock so responders are not delayed at a single access point.

wildfire.conditions: Open Terrain; Scattered Shrubs; Scattered Shrubs; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Long Driveway; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Water Feature; Grass Cover; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Ground Vegetation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing close to the house on all sides.
• Thin the tree cluster near the structure to open up space between individual trees.
• Remove or cut back ground vegetation growing directly against the foundation.
• Keep grass mowed short in the areas between shrubs and the house.
• Clear overhanging branches from trees that extend over the roofline or close to the structure.
• Remove dead grass and dried plant material from around the base of shrubs near the house.
• Maintain the open separation between the scattered trees and shrubs to prevent vegetation from connecting.
• Keep the full length of the driveway clear of overhanging branches to allow emergency vehicle access.
• Cut back any shrubs or tall grass that narrow the driveway edges.
• Thin scattered trees along the driveway to maintain clear sightlines and movement along the full length of the drive.
• Remove dead branches from trees near the structure down to a height that keeps them well above any nearby shrubs or ground vegetation.
• Keep the area around the water feature clear of dead or dried plant material that could carry fire toward the house.
